selection_rationale: Directly targets the highest-priority gap (closed-loop LLM→verifier→sandbox) with a falsifiable paired design, strong venue relevance, and feasible resource requirements; critiques are addressable by concrete preregistration repairs.
unresolved_uncertainties: Sandbox fidelity vs production networks (external validity of observed harms)
Completeness and soundness of the verifier rule-set (risk of systematic false negatives)
Generalizability across LLMs and prompt variants (single-model risk)
Operational trade-off between conservative verifier thresholds and human-review burden
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify verifier tool name, exact version, and publish the machine-readable verifier rule-set (or include it in artifact bundle)
Ensure paired-design implementation uses identical generated-config candidates per intent for baseline vs verifier-assisted runs (or justify alternative)
Increase or stratify sandbox-topology diversity and intent-class representation (or justify representativeness) and document sandbox fidelity limits
Add at least one additional LLM and at least one prompt-variation to test generalizability, and record seeds/meta
Perform and record a pre-study power/sample-size analysis for the pre-registered effect-size target (>30% relative reduction)
